name: Navygrey

the-easy-cardigan-carmine.d: The cardigan that makes getting dressed easier. Slightly boxier and slightly shorter, with the double neck trim that anchors and elevates the piece. Our master British knitters knit the superfine Scottish-spun lambswool more compactly, giving it softness with enough substance to hold its shape. The result? A cardigan that sits just right, however you wear it. Pre order for delivery 3rd week October.

the-heirloom-cardigan-navy.d: One of our original styles, The Heirloom Cardigan is back by request. Knitted in a chunky fisherman rib, it has deep pockets, a cocooning hem and a softly oversized fit. The longer length and set-in sleeves give it shape without losing that feeling of being wrapped up. Made from 100% superfine Scottish-spun lambswool, certified to the Responsible Wool Standard, with buttons made from recycled horn. Orders will be dispatched by the end of October.

the-easy-cardigan-fossil.d: The cardigan that makes getting dressed easier. Slightly boxier, slightly shorter and designed to work just as well buttoned up as it does worn open or layered. Wear it buttoned as a knit or open as a layer. It drapes with beautiful ease. Knitted and hand-finished in the British Isles, with Mother of Pearl buttons - made for the kind of everyday wear we love.

Knitted in a fine 14-gauge, with clean lines and finished with Mother of Pearl buttons. Orders will be dispatched by mid October.

the-original-cardigan-feldspar-navy-marl.d: A good cardigan. A proper cup of tea. Some things belong together. Our original cardigan, reimagined with Feldspar. A perennial bestseller with a little family history: the starting point was the cardigan our founder Rachel’s grandfather wore daily. He knew a good thing when he found it. We've added a little more length than the original, but everything else remains the same easy shape Knitted in the British Isles from 100% Scottish-spun lambswool, with our signature horizontal placket. Feldspar brings the tea: Bespoke, biodegradable Codelite® buttons have a durable, glossy finish inspired by the studio’s signature fine bone china. Keep the cardigan plain or choose to have a complimentary…

the-british-jersey-the-rugby-feldspar.d: A proper cup of tea. A proper rugby jersey. Much to agree on. A limited edition, signature rugby, reimagined with Feldspar. Navygrey x Feldspar is a collaboration of two British brands with a shared fondness for things made well - and used daily. The rugby has a little family history. Our founder’s father wore the jersey that inspired it back in 1993, sleeves rolled up. We’ve kept its familiar spirit, given it more flattering ease through the chest and arms, and left the woven collar just as a rugby collar should be. Roy and Helen make each one here in the UK, using substantial cotton jersey that breathes. Feldspar brings the tea: a teacup and teapot, embroidered in navy on the sleeves.…

the-feldspar-hoody-navy.d: Off duty. Tea ready. Limited edition. Our original hoody, reimagined with Feldspar. Early mornings. Cool evenings. A second cup before you get going. Made from organic brushback cotton, soft on the inside with a reassuring weight. A slightly longer take on our original vintage fit, with a boxy body that doesn’t grip, easy raglan sleeves and pockets to settle your hands into. A double-faced hood holds its shape. Feldspar brings the tea: bespoke tea embroidery in ecru on the sleeves and 'Objects for Life' behind the hood. The limited edition embroidery ledger is now open. Choose your size and once ordered, we'll embroider it especially for you, by hand. Order by 18th October for delivery…

the-heirloom-cardigan-ecru.d: One of our original styles, The Heirloom Cardigan is back by request, in our signature Undyed Ecru shade. the-feldspar-navygrey-mug-white-blue.d: A proper cup of tea. Created with Feldspar, who take their tea as seriously as we take our wool. Handmade from fine bone china, with a clear glaze that brings out its crisp white and gently dimpled surface. A mug that settles comfortably into your hand. They’ve given the size considerable thought. Not so big that the tea goes cold. Not so small that you’re straight back at the kettle. With an elegant but sturdy handle for those first steaming sips. Our bespoke design adds a fine, flowing line around the rim and along the handle, painted by hand. A thread of colour, bringing our world of fibre to Feldspar’s fine bone china.

In a mid to lighter-weight gauge, with no shoulder seams or bulky joins, it sits beautifully against the body. Knitted in Scotland with 100% superfine lamb’s wool - using seamless circular technology, it delivers a clean fit with just the right amount of drape. Think early 90s Vogue. This is the kind of knit that slips into your wardrobe with confidence - polished enough for dinner, relaxed enough for Sundays. Modern. Minimal. Endlessly wearable.

Dress up or keep it casual - it's the shape you’ll keep reaching for all year round.

the-summer-sweater-lightweight-navy.d: For cool mornings. For over-air-conditioned trains. For eating outside when you hadn't planned to. For British weather. For staying longer. For packing lighter. Designed for all the moments summer throws your way.

the-summer-cardigan-lightweight-ecru.d: The Original Cardigan reworked for warmer days. The cardigan has always been one of our most-loved shapes. For summer, we've kept everything that makes it a favourite - the same maker, the same fit, the same ease - and reworked it in our lightweight linen and wool blend. Easy to throw over a tee on cooler mornings, drape over your shoulders as the sun goes down or keep close by when you're not quite sure what the day has in store. Softly relaxed, breathable and effortless to wear, it's the cardigan version of The Summer Knit philosophy: light enough to bring everywhere, useful enough that you often will. The layer you'll be glad is within reach.

the-maree-jacket-undyed-ecru.d: A jacket, the Navygrey way. Designed to be worn a little more like outerwear - relaxed and easy - to reach for as the seasons begin to shift. Knitted in England from 100% Scottish-spun wool, it carries the same comforting softness you know from our knitwear, with a slightly more substantial feel that works beautifully as a light layer. The shape is gently oversized, with a soft sleeve that gives it an effortless drape. Finished with British-made corozo nut buttons and subtle fully-fashioned details. Layer over our signature linen tee and add denim for an on-repeat look that works every time.

Created with artist Martha Holmes, our limited-edition blanket scarf began with her painting Porthmeor Sea . We worked with Clare in the Scottish Highlands to turn its navy, pink, sienna and sea blue into a woven check. Made for the cold days ahead, with a little of summer still in it.

the-layered-tee-01-white.t: The Layered Tee / Long Sleeve - White
the-layered-tee-01-white.d: A much-loved silhouette, with a nod to the 90s - born out of our instinct for layering. The Layered Tee creates the look of two pieces worn together, without any of the weight. Cut from our super soft, lightweight organic slub cotton, it takes everything we love about the layered look - and distils it into one considered piece. Wear it as you would a favourite t-shirt - with denim, loose and undone - or let it sit neatly, tucked in and under a jacket for something a touch more pulled together. It does the work of layering, without asking you to think about it.

the-easy-shirt-white.d: Inspired by our much-loved Easy knit, we set out to create a piece with the same effortless feel. Slightly shorter and a little boxier, it's designed through a feminine lens with clean, modern lines. A softly gathered back, relaxed cuff, gentle collar and beautifully finished interior create structure without stiffness, while the tumbled-washed organic cotton gives it a softness that feels familiar from the very first wear. It isn't a formal shirt, and it was never meant to be. It's designed to feel easy. Modern without trying too hard. Feminine without feeling fussy. We recommend sizing down by one for the fit as shown.

the-layered-tee-short-white.t: The Layered Tee / Short Sleeve - White
the-layered-tee-short-white.d: A much-loved silhouette, with a nod to the 90s - reworked for warmer days. The Short Sleeve Layered Tee creates the look of two pieces worn together, without any of the weight. Cut from our super soft, lightweight organic slub cotton, it brings the ease of a classic short sleeve t-shirt together with the considered feel of a layered look. Wear it with denim, loose and undone, or tuck it neatly under a jacket when you want something a little more pulled together. It does the work of layering, without asking you to think about it.

the-oversize-shirt-salt-blue.d: Our first shirt, built on the same philosophy as every Navygrey knit. Crafted from tumble washed organic cotton, it's designed to feel familiar from the very first wear. Taking its cues from our much-loved knit of the same name, with a relaxed silhouette, a softened collar and gentle volume through the sleeves, balanced by an effortless cuff. A longer-line length with a softly curved hem while thoughtfully positioned buttons - including one just above the bra line – to create a more flattering, versatile and comfortable fit. The right weight. The right amount of ease. A piece that allows the other things in your wardrobe to do more. One that works with linen, tucked into denim, layered under knitwear or thrown on with little thought at all. Crafted from our lightweight slub cotton (that's the same as our Layered Tees ) and inspired by the fit of our much-loved Relaxed Jumper, the Relaxed Tee is easy, flattering and endlessly wearable. A neatly balanced neckline. Soft sleeves with a turn-back cuff detail. Just the right amount of slouch.

about.sum:
Remember the feeling?
That sensation you get when you pull on your favourite jumper? The warmth. The comfort. The familiarity.
Like you’ve come back home and everything’s going to be all right. We take the time to create things that bring that feeling back.
Inspired by the clothes that have earned a lasting place in our lives, we make pieces with the same potential.
Exceptional materials. Shapes considered down to the last centimetre. Clothes that feel good. Fit well. Wear well. And become part of your life.
Made by people who know exactly what they are doing.
Learn More About Our Materials: The beginning
This isn’t a story. It’s history. My life history.
The funny thing is - the favourite jumper wasn’t even mine. It was my mum’s. A navy lambswool with a round neck. A classic.
I spent 20 years trying to find a jumper that felt that good. I couldn’t. Not new. Not vintage. Not anywhere.
But I wanted that feeling again. So I decided to recreate it.

Built to last. Made to matter.
We don't chase trends. We craft them - carefully, deliberately, and with purpose.
As a Certified B Corporation, we meet the highest standards of social and environmental performance. But certifications are just the beginning. For us, sustainability isn't a badge; it's a baseline.
We’re a small team of women building this brand - piece by piece, choice by choice. That means no shortcuts, no box-ticking. Just a commitment to doing things properly.
We're a Certified B Corporation®
We're thrilled to announce that in 2023 we proudly certified as a B Corp™. B Corp formalises what has been there at the start of Navygrey - a commitment to use business as a force for good; to benefit all people, communities and the planet.
Find Out More
"Transparency Triumphs in This Brand Story.": The Daily Telegraph

Privacy policy
Privacy Policy
At Navygrey, your privacy is taken seriously. We work hard to ensure we only use your information in the way that you have agreed.
Our Privacy Policy, below, explains what information we collect on our website and how it is used.
To help protect your data, please do not disclose to anybody else your login, password or any other details relating to your Navygrey account or transactions.
What do we do with your information?
When you purchase something from our online store, as part of the buying and selling process, we collect the personal information you give us such as your name, address and email address.
When you browse our online store, we also automatically receive your computer’s or device’s internet protocol (IP) address in order to provide us with information that helps us learn about your browser and operating system.
With your permission, we may send you emails about our online store, new products and other updates.

Free Returns & Exchanges for UK orders
We hope that you’ll love your Navygrey jumper.
If for some reason you are not completely satisfied, we offer UK Returns and Exchanges up to 14 days from receipt of your order.
If you return your item within 14 days of receipt of order, we offer free UK Returns & Exchanges (stock permitting). However, if you wish to return your item after 14 days, you will be charged £5.75 for the return of your product.
To request a return, please use our returns portal.
We will provide Royal Mail returns labels or QR code free of charge for orders returned within 14 days. However, if you request a return between 14-30 days of receipt of purchase you will be charged £5.75
If you wish to use an alternative provider and choose ‘Use your own shipping label’, this cost will not be reimbursed, and you must include your order information within your parcel.
Please ensure you obtain proof of postage from the Post Office when you drop the package off as we cannot be held responsible for for item(s) lost in transit.
